title: Replication kit and formal artifact: error geometry of interatomic-potential elastic predictions (classical potentials, foundation MLIPs, DFT implementations), including failed preregistered follow-ups
description: Two-tier replication kit for the error-geometry working papers: Tier 1 reproduces every factorial statistic from committed raw data using NumPy alone; Tier 2 re-derives raw elastic constants from public model checkpoints with a bit-exact-regression harness. Includes pinned datasets for 559 classical model–element tensors (423 distinct KIM ids), 8 MatPES-trained foundation MLIPs, and 12 ACWF DFT method configurations; three pre-registrations with commit hashes; referee-driven robustness analyses; and pointers to the Lean 4 theory core (zero sorry, zero new axioms), which checks the stated mathematics, not the physics, the reference data or the pipeline. The preregistered Round-2 3×3×3 follow-up did not reproduce the functional-clustering result (H1/H2a kill conditions triggered; H2b and H4 coverage missed their thresholds); see the README status note.
